findings.description: The loop now only removes each parameter's primary `opts`, dropping the earlier removal of `secondary_opts`. A help option name that matches a parameter's secondary option (for example `--no-verbose` from `--verbose/--no-verbose`) is no longer excluded.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command has a flag `--verbose/--no-verbose` and `help_option_names` includes `--no-verbose`. Before the change, `--no-verbose` was removed from the help names, so it was not claimed twice. Now it stays, so the help option is registered with a name the flag already uses. Impact: the parser sees a conflicting option name, so one of the two options silently stops working.
